verdict.rationale: Morph is fundamentally an API product. It documents an OpenAI-compatible base URL (`https://api.morphllm.com/v1`) where one key covers chat models, Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact and Reflexes, plus a native Anthropic Messages endpoint at `/v1/messages`, a create/poll/classify job flow for custom Reflexes, and request parameters like `service_tier`. A machine-readable llms.txt and .md docs are live, and an independent hands-on user got the OpenAI-compatible endpoint working from their own CLI tool. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404).
